## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Test only
- [ ] Internal refactor (no user-visible change)

## PR checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes locally (all four test suites)
- [ ] `make bench-retrieval` nDCG@5 delta is at least 0, or the regression is justified in the description
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` section has a one-line entry for this change
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior changed (`docs/`, `README.md`)
- [ ] No `<private>...</private>` literal in tracked files
